Combat mechanics

Tournament projection

The Tournament bracket on Jade Tide exactly as the client received it on 2026-09-19, played on the team simulator: 300 fights per match, the winner advances. 64 preliminary divisions, 144 teams. Projected champion: Scripts.

8matches simulated
136decided by Power rank
112byes
10teams with all four sheets

A match is simulated only when all eight players have captured sheets (a bold member name). Otherwise the team with the better Power rank advances, and the row says so. The preliminaries are the game's own pairings and byes; the later rounds pair the winners in bracket order. Knockout groups are an assumption: the 64 projected winners seeded by Power rank in snake order into four groups; the game does not publish its rule. The engine's known gaps are listed on the team simulator page; a bracket is a ladder of 50/50 coin flips at the top, so read the odds, not just the winner.

Purrwikimania — an independent, fan-made reference for Sword x Staff (Boltray Games). Every number here is read directly out of the game's own configuration files and decompiled code, not from testing or estimation. Item names are the game's official English strings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Boltray Games. Game names, images and data are the property of their owners. Figures reflect the client build they were extracted from and can change with any patch — see Method for exactly what was read and when.
